Add Breed Information to a Visit Table

Source: R/add_breed.R
add_breed.Rd

Merge a table of pig IDs and breeds into a visit table from prep_visits().

add_breed(visits, breeds, id = "responder", breed = "breed", verbose = 1)

Arguments

visits

Visit table from prep_visits().

breeds

A data frame with one row per pig: the pig ID and its breed (or line).

id

Name of the ID column in breeds. It is matched to the transponder number responder_raw, then to responder. Unidentified visits get no breed. Default "responder".

breed

Name of the breed column in breeds. Default "breed".

verbose

0 (silent), 1 (summary, default) or 2 (details).

Value

The visit table with a breed column (character, NA for unidentified visits and for pigs not found in breeds). Attributes of visits are kept.

Examples

visits <- prep_visits(nedap, verbose = 0)
# a breed table from your own herd records, one row per pig
pigs <- unique(visits[identified == TRUE, responder])
breeds <- data.frame(responder = pigs, breed = rep(c("YY", "LL"), length.out = length(pigs)))
visits <- add_breed(visits, breeds)
#> ✔ Breed added for 30 of 30 pigs: LL (15), YY (15)
table(unique(visits[identified == TRUE, .(responder, breed)])$breed)
#> 
#> LL YY 
#> 15 15
